reuse.why: Edits only the existing shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the rule stays in one function.

placement.why: The change sits in shared/schedules.ts where the expected-amount rule already lives.

scope.why: Minimal edit of the rule plus updated tests.

maintainability.why: Simpler expression (Math.min, amount minus threshold) with a comment stating the rule.
